# Attribution

`dsl.py`, `arc_types.py`, `constants.py` and `LICENSE` are copied unmodified from
Michael Hodel's ARC-DSL, https://github.com/michaelhodel/arc-dsl (MIT License, see `LICENSE`).

contamination risk) and the re-arc generators (large; referenced at a configurable path, see ../../README.md).
